mapper.sql: FROM coreerp.shipments s JOIN coreerp.sales_orders o ON o.id=s.sales_order_id JOIN coreerp.shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=s.id JOIN coreerp.sales_order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id AND oi.product_id=si.product_id WHERE s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at >= #{from} AND s.created_at < #{to}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coreerp.daily_product_summaries(business_date,product_id,quantity,amount) SELECT #{date},si.product_id,sum(si.quantity),sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity) GROUP BY si.product_id
INSERT INTO coreerp.daily_customer_summaries(business_date,customer_id,quantity,amount) SELECT #{date},o.customer_id,sum(si.quantity),sum(oi.unit_price*si.quantity) GROUP BY o.customer_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coreerp.daily_summaries s LEFT JOIN coreerp.daily_summary_sources r USING(business_date) WHERE s.business_date=#{date}
SELECT FROM coreerp.daily_summaries s LEFT JOIN coreerp.daily_summary_sources r USING(business_date) WHERE s.business_date >= #{from} AND s.business_date <= #{to} ORDER BY s.business_date DESC
